card.name: Astronomical distances before light-years
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces just before a distance in light-years, such as 'about', 'of' or a digit, in astronomy news about galaxies.

modes.label: Lead-in to a distance
modes.description: A word like 'about' or 'of' right before a distance figure for a galaxy.
modes.example: Markarian 231 is located<< about>> 600 million light years away

modes.label: Digits inside the distance
modes.description: Digits or number words within a light-year distance figure.
